IBC AGENTS

RESOLUTION BAZAAR is a platform for AI-driven automation in insolvency, bankruptcy, and financial resolution processes. It empowers insolvency professionals, creditors, auditors, and regulators with intelligent tools for claim verification, asset valuation, compliance monitoring, and investor outreach. By leveraging AI agents, it streamlines document management, risk assessment, and predictive analytics, ensuring faster and more efficient resolutions.

Auditors – AI agents detect financial anomalies, automate audits, and ensure compliance in IBC cases.

Claimants – AI-driven platforms streamline claim filing, verification, and real-time status tracking.

Committees – AI tools assist in decision-making by analyzing resolution plans and financial viability.

Creditors – AI agents assess recovery probabilities, optimize debt resolution, and provide automated updates.

Debtors – AI-driven restructuring models help debtors with repayment planning and compliance tracking.

Investors – AI-powered insights identify distressed asset opportunities and match investors with viable cases.

Marketers – AI-driven campaigns enhance outreach for resolution plans and distressed asset sales.

Professionals – AI automates document management, risk assessment, and resolution planning for experts.

Regulators – AI ensures legal compliance, monitors proceedings, and flags irregularities in insolvency cases.

Valuers – AI-driven valuation models provide accurate assessments of distressed assets and liabilities.
